The workflow can therefore publish credentials from working-session traces. Redact these authentication forms before reporting or mining them.

**[P2]** **Truncated failure output produces false zero evidence.** [mine-trace-failures.py:285](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:285) discards text beyond `MAX_TEXT_CHARS`, but the resulting evidence does not mark that search as truncated. Match against the complete output, or mark affected counts unknown.
